title: Hosted connection
responsibility: Shows shared-project connectivity and the browser sign-in handoff for this device.

inputs.name: HostedConnection.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace used once to create connection state. Loads that state on mount and disposes it on unmount; the connection store owns endpoint and session operations.

inputs.name: HostedConnection.compact
inputs.description: Optional compact styling flag, false by default; does not change the available connection actions.

outputs.name: HostedConnection
outputs.description: Renders when support and status exist. Shows not-configured guidance, signed-in identity with Disconnect, or browser sign-in code with expiry/waiting text and Cancel. Shows only the store-approved address, otherwise an invalid-address alert. Other states offer Connect shared projects. Busy disables actions; store errors are alerts.
